defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Press whenever your health dips below 50% to restore a chunk of HP; its short cooldown means you can use it freely throughout the fight.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Press proactively right before any telegraphed AoE damage event; the short cooldown allows near-constant uptime during AoE-heavy phases.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Use to immune or purge a dangerous magical ability or debuff; press it proactively since the window is only 5 seconds.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Use ahead of a burst of physical damage or a physical tankbuster cleave for near-total dodge over 10 seconds.
